# SetSlot

A running-order row: slot number, energy against the slot's target, the TrackCell, BPM and key, and lock / move up / move down / remove, with spare suggestions…

`SongNodes.SetSlot` · Music

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.SetSlot index={0} targetEnergy={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.SetSlot" index="{{0}}" target-energy="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (SetSlotProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` * | `number` | Slot number, 1-based. |
| `targetEnergy` * | `number` | Target energy for this slot from the set shape. |
| `track` | `TrackCellProps & { energy: number \| null; bpm: number \| null; key: string \| null }` | The track in this slot; omit for an empty slot. |
| `locked` | `boolean` | Locked slots survive "Try another take" and cannot move. |
| `now` | `boolean` | Current slot while playing. |
| `spares` | `{ artist: string; title: string; energy: number; key: string }[]` | Up to 3 spare suggestions. |
| `emptyReason` | `string` | Why the slot is empty and what to do. |
| `onLock` | `(locked: boolean) => void` | Action handlers. |
| `onMove` | `(direction: "up" \| "down") => void` |  |
| `onRemove` | `() => void` |  |
| `onSwapIn` | `(spareIndex: number) => void` |  |
